title: Getting started with citelens
text: convert_refworks() reads RefWorks export returns BibTeX entries. accepts RefWorks Tagged Format (lines RT, A1, T1) RIS (lines TY  -, AU  -), detects one supplied. Citation keys built first author, year, first meaningful word title (example tinto2006research). letter added two keys otherwise collide.
